summary:
AstraCare is an offline-first, edge-intelligent astronaut health and telemetry platform engineered for deep-space exploration. Developed with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Express, and Gemini AI, it combines 256-bit AES-GCM encrypted vaults (<150ms unlock) with HL7 FHIR R4 clinical telemetry.
AstraCare guarantees autonomy during communication blackouts, featuring qualified crew onboarding, an Emergency Open Login roster, Ground Surgeon surveillance, and 12-hazard tracking (SANS, radiation, bone loss). Crew build resilience through cognitive games and sensory drills like eye-tracking pacers and box breathing. It transforms aerospace healthcare from reactive intervention into predictive, air-gapped edge medicine for space and remote Earth environments.
details: Hosted at probable-pudding.vercel.app, AstraCare is an offline-first astronaut health monitoring and clinical telemetry platform. It processes microgravity biometrics, biomedical lab payloads, and hazard logs via secure PostgreSQL/Supabase databases, React 19, and Tailwind CSS. The app benefits deep-space missions by ensuring resilient offline edge-sync during blackouts, enforcing role-based medical security, and providing automated AI health insights. It creatively merges aerospace-grade telemetry tracking with a shared crew knowledge blog. Considerations included microgravity ergonomics, low-latency data handling, and rigorous HIPAA-compliant data boundaries for orbital crews.
